risks: Our business and revenues in the manufacturing segment for PSC sleepers are substantially dependent on railroad infrastructure projects undertaken or awarded by government authorities and other government owned public sector undertakings and are thereby dependent on governmental policies and budgetary allocation, accordingly, 38.76%, 47.30%, 58.09% and 58.54% of our revenue from operations during the six months period ended September 30 2025, Fiscal 2025, Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2023 was generated from government authorities and entities related to the government in the manufacturing segment for Pre-Stressed Concrete (PSC) sleepers.

Our primary business vertical is the manufacture & supply of PSC sleepers mainly for Indian Railways and DFCCIL Projects (PSC sleeper vertical), accounting for 38.76%, 47.30%, 58.09% and 58.54% of our revenue during the six months period ended September 30, 2025 and Fiscal 2025, Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2023, respectively.

As a manufacturer of PSC sleepers, our scope of services, product specifications, delivery schedules and unit rates, are primarily determined by the periodic purchase orders issued under a tender awarded by the respective zonal segments of the Indian Railways.
We depend significantly on a certain number of customers for our business and revenue.
A substantial decrease in the orders placed on us by these customers or a decrease in the demand of these products may adversely impact our revenues and profitability.

Our total revenue generated from our manufacturing and service business are predominantly derived from certain number of customers including but not limited to Northern Railways, Central Railways, North Central Railways, West Central Railways, Larsen & Toubro, Limited, Samruddhi Industries, Kalpataru Projects International Limited, ISC Projects Limited and Raj Infrastructure Development (India) Private Limited.
Names of certain customers have not been disclosed here due to non-receipt of consent.

Our consistent top ten customers across the last three Fiscals include Indian Railways, Larsen & Toubro, Limited, KEC International Limited, Samruddhi Industries, ISC Projects Limited, Raj Infrastructure Development (India) Private Limited and Kalpataru Projects International Limited.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The disposable income during the FY 2018- 25 has increased from INR 131,753 to INR 233,420, increasing at CAGR 8.5% while in FY 2025 it is estimated to grow at 8.59% on year-on-year basis in FY 2025 against 8.49% in FY 2024.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: This represents a modest but stable CAGR of 1.4%, underscoring the consistent role of sleepers in railway infrastructure expansion and modernization worldwide.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The relatively moderate CAGR suggests that while new installations are contributing, a significant portion of the demand comes from replacement of ageing tracks and sleepers.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Overall, between FY 2021 and FY 2024, the sector recorded a strong CAGR of 18.4%, showcasing rapid growth in this phase.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Every 10.10 14.70 15.70 16.70 17.90 FY 2021 FY 2022 FY 2023 FY 2024 FY 2025 Annual Consumption of Concrete Sleepers & Historical Growth Trend (In Million Units) Expansion of Railway Network Urban Transport and Metro Rail Growth Track Renewal and Replacement Programs Freight Corridor Development Railway Modernization Initiatives Government Investment and Policy Push kilometre of new track requires thousands of sleepers, making network expansion the most direct growth driver.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Between FY 2021 and FY 2025, global production of mild steel pipes and tubes rose from 60.3 million tonnes to 68.6 million tonnes, marking a CAGR of 3.3%, while consumption increased from 52.6 million tonnes to 61.2 million tonnes, growing at a slightly higher CAGR of 3.9%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The stronger CAGR in consumption compared to production reflects robust end-use demand, particularly in emerging markets and energy-intensive sectors.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: This projected expansion highlights a robust CAGR over the five-year period, fuelled by increasing industrialization, urban infrastructure upgrades, and rising global demand for cost-effective and versatile construction materials.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Production & Consumption Overview: Global production is projected to increase from 68.6 million tonnes in FY 2025 to 90.2 million tonnes by FY 2030, at a CAGR of 5.6%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence

financial_valuation.risk: Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also impair our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.

If any or a combination of the following risks, or if any of the risks that are currently not known or deemed to be not relevant or material now actually occur or become material in the future, our business, cash flows, prospects, financial condition and results of operations could suffer, the trading price of the Equity Shares could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment.

If government authorities and public sector authorities were to reduce their volume of business with our Company, or if the Indian Railways does not release any new tenders, our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows may be adversely affected.

internal_operational.risk: Our business and revenues in the manufacturing segment for PSC sleepers are substantially dependent on railroad infrastructure projects undertaken or awarded by government authorities and other government owned public sector undertakings and are thereby dependent on governmental policies and budgetary allocation, accordingly, 38.76%, 47.30%, 58.09% and 58.54% of our revenue from operations during the six months period ended September 30 2025, Fiscal 2025, Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2023 was generated from government authorities and entities related to the government in the manufacturing segment for Pre-Stressed Concrete (PSC) sleepers.

Our primary business vertical is the manufacture & supply of PSC sleepers mainly for Indian Railways and DFCCIL Projects (PSC sleeper vertical), accounting for 38.76%, 47.30%, 58.09% and 58.54% of our revenue during the six months period ended September 30, 2025 and Fiscal 2025, Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2023, respectively.

As a manufacturer of PSC sleepers, our scope of services, product specifications, delivery schedules and unit rates, are primarily determined by the periodic purchase orders issued under a tender awarded by the respective zonal segments of the Indian Railways.

strategy_growth.risk: We may be unable to adequately protect our intellectual property and may be subject to risks of infringement claims.

As of the date of this Draft Red Herring Prospectus, our Company has applied for the device mark under classes 19, 37 and 40 which are currently pending before the authorities as further detailed in the chapter “Government and Other Approvals- Intellectual Property” on page 423.

While we take care to ensure that we comply with the intellectual property rights of third parties, we cannot determine with certainty whether we are infringing upon any existing third-party intellectual property rights.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Our business and revenues in the manufacturing segment for PSC sleepers are substantially dependent on railroad infrastructure projects undertaken or awarded by government authorities and other government owned public sector undertakings and are thereby dependent on governmental policies and budgetary allocation, accordingly, 38.76%, 47.30%, 58.09% and 58.54% of our revenue from operations during the six months period ended September 30 2025, Fiscal 2025, Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2023 was generated from government authorities and entities related to the government in the manufacturing segment for Pre-Stressed Concrete (PSC) sleepers.
- Our primary business vertical is the manufacture & supply of PSC sleepers mainly for Indian Railways and DFCCIL Projects (PSC sleeper vertical), accounting for 38.76%, 47.30%, 58.09% and 58.54% of our revenue during the six months period ended September 30, 2025 and Fiscal 2025, Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2023, respectively.
- As a manufacturer of PSC sleepers, our scope of services, product specifications, delivery schedules and unit rates, are primarily determined by the periodic purchase orders issued under a tender awarded by the respective zonal segments of the Indian Railways.
- We depend significantly on a certain number of customers for our business and revenue.
- A substantial decrease in the orders placed on us by these customers or a decrease in the demand of these products may adversely impact our revenues and profitability.
- Our total revenue generated from our manufacturing and service business are predominantly derived from certain number of customers including but not limited to Northern Railways, Central Railways, North Central Railways, West Central Railways, Larsen & Toubro, Limited, Samruddhi Industries, Kalpataru Projects International Limited, ISC Projects Limited and Raj Infrastructure Development (India) Private Limited.
- Names of certain customers have not been disclosed here due to non-receipt of consent.
- Our consistent top ten customers across the last three Fiscals include Indian Railways, Larsen & Toubro, Limited, KEC International Limited, Samruddhi Industries, ISC Projects Limited, Raj Infrastructure Development (India) Private Limited and Kalpataru Projects International Limited.
